minimum_items_per_day_rule_source: data/evaluation/w06/w06_measurement_contract_v1.json (DAY_STRUCTURE lists minimum_required_items_per_day without freezing a numeric constant > 1; apps/ai-service/app/schemas/planner_benchmark.py BenchmarkItineraryDay.items enforces min_length=1 and legacy data/evaluation/planner/evaluate_planner.py:L39 defaults min_items_per_day=1)

P1.contract_requirement: Controlled activity_kind ('POI_VISIT' | 'TRANSIT_ONLY') on every itinerary item, with canonical place_id REQUIRED iff activity_kind == 'POI_VISIT' (and fail-closed INVALID_OR_SCHEMA_NONCOMPLIANT_ITEM on missing/unknown activity_kind).
P1.evidence: BenchmarkItineraryItem (01A) enforces controlled activity_kind ('POI_VISIT' | 'TRANSIT_ONLY') and required place_id; planner_benchmark_evaluator.py (01B) deterministically enforces TRANSIT_ONLY_NAMED_POI_VIOLATION when a TRANSIT_ONLY item carries a non-null place_name.

P2.contract_requirement: Deterministic catalog membership validation against frozen REC-A-CORE-V2 catalog for all POI_VISIT items.
P2.evidence: evaluate_benchmark_scenario in apps/ai-service/app/evaluation/planner_benchmark_evaluator.py validates every POI_VISIT item's place_id against the 622 REC-A-CORE-V2 POIs in data/curated/gomate_places_freeze_v2.json without place_name inference.

P3.contract_requirement: Destination membership validation by canonical place_id for all POI_VISIT items.
P3.evidence: evaluate_benchmark_scenario verifies that every grounded POI_VISIT item's catalog destination_slug equals scenario.destination_slug and computes destination_correct_poi_rate and scenario_destination_valid.

P4.contract_requirement: Canonical duplicate-place validation by place_id across POI_VISIT items.
P4.evidence: evaluate_benchmark_scenario counts repeated canonical place_id values across POI_VISIT items and enforces duplicate_poi_violation_count == 0 when allow_revisit_place_ids == false.

P5.contract_requirement: HH:MM time parser, start_time < end_time validator, and intra-day interval overlap checker.
P5.evidence: parse_strict_hhmm and evaluate_benchmark_scenario validate 24-hour HH:MM strings (00:00..23:59), enforce start_time < end_time, and detect intra-day overlaps using half-open [start, end) intervals.

P6.contract_requirement: Estimated-budget ceiling checker separate from real-world price-grounding claims.
P6.evidence: evaluate_benchmark_scenario computes estimated_total_cost across all items, checks estimated_total_cost <= scenario.budget (or NOT_APPLICABLE when budget is null), and separately verifies ARITHMETIC_SELF_CONSISTENCY against day_cost and budget_analysis.estimated_cost.

P7.contract_requirement: Opening-hours parser with explicit three-state (COMPLIANT / VIOLATION / UNKNOWN) handling where known VIOLATION fails CORE_SCENARIO_PASS and UNKNOWN remains neutral.
P7.evidence: Deferred to W06-INSTRUMENT-01C; ScenarioEvaluationResult records opening_hours_status = 'NOT_EVALUATED_IN_01B' and computes core_scenario_pass_pre_opening_hours only.

P8.contract_requirement: Benchmark harness that rejects mock/fallback execution (FAIL CLOSED on MOCK_OR_FALLBACK_RUN) and retains invalid runs in the primary 100-scenario denominator.
P8.evidence: Single-scenario runner (01A) and evaluator (01B) fail closed on non-VALID runs (classification INVALID_RUN, core_scenario_pass_pre_opening_hours = false); 100-scenario batch denominator aggregation belongs to 01C.

P9.contract_requirement: Raw provider response and parsed PlanResponse output persistence for evaluation runs.
P9.evidence: 01A persists scenario_input.json, raw_provider_response.txt, parsed_plan_response.json, and run_manifest.json; 01B persists deterministic scenario_evaluation.json.

P10.contract_requirement: Cryptographic reproducibility run manifest capturing all required SHA256 digests and run metadata.
P10.evidence: 01A and 01B verify scenario_sha256, catalog_sha256, and parsed_response_sha256 under W06-ARTIFACT-HASH-BASIS-V1 and record source_run_manifest_sha256 and evaluator_code_sha256; batch benchmark manifest belongs to 01C.

P11.contract_requirement: Frozen 100-scenario benchmark manifest (34 ha-noi, 33 da-nang, 33 ha-long) with per-scenario SHA256.
P11.evidence: Deferred to the dedicated W06 100-scenario freeze task (final_100_scenarios_generated = false).

P12.contract_requirement: Benchmark-only execution path that cannot accidentally return canned mock responses as scientific evidence.
P12.evidence: Benchmark execution (01A) and deterministic evaluation (01B) are completely isolated from the production POST /planner mock fallback.
